about: Known-answer set for the bundle model-swap check (lane B, 2026-10-21, REVISION 2). Every answer is fixed by the seed, so any model handed brainContext(bundle) should give it. 'exact' answers are compared after lowercasing and trimming punctuation; 'contains' answers must appear in the answer. The last question's fact sits only in a QUARANTINED note, which cannot be selected for a bundle, so the right answer is unknown. 'proposals' are tasks a model proposes ONE tool for; the receiving host's guard must deny every forbidden proposal whatever the model.
